product_overview: A personal finance dashboard for authenticated users to track transactions, manage spending categories, and view financial analytics. The app also supports account registration, login, email verification, and sign out, with offline-first transaction handling.
core_goals: Filter transactions to focus on specific spending and income activity
View financial charts and reports to understand spending patterns
Register, verify, sign in, and sign out of an account
Switch the interface language between English and Russian

features.name: Authentication - Login
features.description: Allow existing users to sign in with email and password to access the finance dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the login form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /auth/login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an authentication error message

features.name: Authentication - Register
features.description: Allow new users to create an account with display name, email, and password.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/register -> Enter display name -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Confirm the password -> Submit the registration form -> See a success message with email verification instructions
Navigate to /auth/register -> Enter a password that is too short -> Submit the registration form -> See a client-side validation error
Navigate to /auth/register -> Enter mismatched passwords -> Submit the registration form -> See a client-side validation error

features.name: Authentication - Email Verification
features.description: Let users complete account verification by opening the verification link and exchanging the code for a session.
user_flows: Navigate to /auth/verify with a verification code in the URL -> Wait while verification is in progress -> See a success message -> Return to the dashboard automatically
Navigate to /auth/verify without a verification code in the URL -> See an error message
Navigate to /auth/verify with an invalid verification code in the URL -> Wait while verification is in progress -> See an error message

features.name: Sign Out
features.description: Allow signed-in users to end their session and return to the public home view.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Sign out -> See the home page

features.name: Dashboard - Transactions View
features.description: Show a transaction list with filters and allow users to create, edit, and delete transactions from the dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the transaction list sorted by newest first -> Filter transactions by type, date range, category, or amount range -> See the list update
Navigate to / -> Open the transaction form -> Enter amount, description, category, date, and transaction type -> Submit the form -> See the new transaction appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Select a transaction for editing -> Update amount, description, category, date, or type -> Submit the form -> See the transaction updates reflected in the list
Navigate to / -> Choose a transaction for deletion -> Confirm removal -> See the transaction disappear from the list

features.name: Dashboard - Charts
features.description: Display financial charts that summarize expenses, income versus expense, monthly trends, top categories, and largest transactions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review the expense chart, income versus expense chart, monthly expense chart, top categories, and largest transactions widgets -> See the charts reflect the current transaction filters
Navigate to / -> Change the transaction filters -> Observe the charts update to match the filtered data

features.name: Transaction Management - Create
features.description: Let users add a new transaction from the dashboard, including support for offline creation.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open the transaction form -> Enter amount, description, category, date, and transaction type -> Submit the form -> See the transaction appear in the list
Navigate to / -> Open the transaction form while offline -> Enter transaction details -> Submit the form -> See the transaction appear immediately with an offline saved state

features.name: Transaction Management - Edit
features.description: Let users update an existing transaction from the dashboard, including support for offline editing.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open an existing transaction for editing -> Change the transaction details -> Submit the form -> See the updated transaction in the list

Navigate to / -> Open an existing transaction for editing while offline -> Change the transaction details -> Submit the form -> See the updated transaction reflected immediately with an offline saved state

features.name: Transaction Management - Delete
features.description: Let users remove a transaction from the dashboard, including support for offline deletion.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Choose a transaction for deletion -> Confirm removal -> See the transaction removed from the list
Navigate to / -> Choose a transaction for deletion while offline -> Confirm removal -> See the transaction removed from the list immediately with an offline saved state

features.name: Offline-First Transaction Sync
features.description: Keep transaction add, edit, and delete actions working offline and synchronize queued changes when connectivity returns.
user_flows: Navigate to / while offline -> See an offline status banner with the number of pending changes -> Create, edit, or delete transactions -> See changes apply immediately and be queued
Navigate to / while offline with previously queued changes -> Return online -> See a syncing status banner -> Wait for synchronization to finish -> See a success message and cleared pending banners
Navigate to / while offline with queued changes -> Reload the page -> See previously deleted transactions remain hidden from the restored cache

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Allow users to view, create, edit, and delete their own transaction categories while preserving system categories.
user_flows: Navigate to /categories -> Review the category table with name, type, emoji, and transaction count -> See system categories and user categories
Navigate to /categories -> Open the category form -> Enter a category name -> Choose an emoji -> Select a type -> Submit the form -> See the new category added to the table
Navigate to /categories -> Select a user category for editing -> Update the name, emoji, or type -> Submit the form -> See the category changes reflected in the table
Navigate to /categories -> Select a user category for deletion -> Confirm removal -> See the category removed from the table
Navigate to /categories -> Try to edit or delete a system category -> See that the action is unavailable

features.name: Language Switcher
features.description: Let users switch the interface language between English and Russian.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Switch the language -> See the interface text update immediately
Navigate to /categories -> Switch the language -> See the interface text update immediately

routes.description: Main dashboard with transaction list, filters, expense/income charts, top categories, and largest transactions widgets
Financial reports page with chart-based analytics
Category management page with CRUD table, emoji picker, and transaction count
Auth hub page with links to login and register
Login page with email and password form
Registration page with email, password, display name form using PKCE flow
Email verification page using PKCE token exchange
Legacy verify route for compatibility with old verification emails

features.name: Authentication - Login
features.description: Login with email and password credentials using Nhost auth
user_interactions: Fill email input field
Fill password input field
Toggle password visibility
Click Login button to submit
See error message on invalid credentials or failed login
Redirect to dashboard on successful login

features.name: Authentication - Register
features.description: Register a new account with email, password, and display name using PKCE flow
user_interactions: Fill display name input field
Fill email input field
Fill password input field (minimum 8 characters)
Fill confirm password input field
Toggle password and confirm password visibility
Click Register button to submit
See client-side validation errors: password too short or passwords mismatch
See success message with instructions to check email for verification link
Redirect to dashboard if session already exists

features.name: Authentication - Email Verification
features.description: Complete email verification by exchanging PKCE code from verification link
user_interactions: Page reads verification code from URL query parameters
Shows verifying spinner while exchanging code
Shows success message and auto-redirects to dashboard after 1.5 seconds
Shows error message if code is missing, verifier is missing, or token exchange fails

features.name: Sign Out
features.description: Sign out the current user, purge Apollo cache, and redirect to home
user_interactions: Click Logout button in sidebar
Session destroyed via nhost.auth.signOut
Apollo cache purged via purgeApolloCache
Redirect to home page

features.name: Dashboard - Transactions View
features.description: View, filter, and manage financial transactions in a dashboard layout
user_interactions: See list of transactions sorted by date descending
Filter transactions by type (income/expense/all), date range, category, and amount range
See dashboard widgets: expense chart, income vs expense chart, monthly expense chart, top categories, largest transactions
See skeleton loading state while data loads
Click Add Transaction button to open transaction form modal
Click edit icon on a transaction to open edit form modal
Click delete icon on a transaction to remove it

api_calls.endpoint: Nhost GraphQL: GET_TRANSACTIONS query, ADD_TRANSACTION, EDIT_TRANSACTION, DELETE_TRANSACTION mutations

features.name: Dashboard - Charts
features.description: Financial data visualization with ECharts widgets
user_interactions: View pie/bar/line charts showing expense breakdown, income vs expense comparison, monthly trends, top spending categories, and largest transactions
Charts update when transaction filters change
See skeleton loading states while chart data loads

features.name: Transaction Management - Create
features.description: Create a new financial transaction with offline support
user_interactions: Click Add Transaction button
Fill amount, description, select category, pick date, choose type (income/expense) in modal form
Submit form to create transaction
When online: transaction saved to server, appears in list immediately
When offline: transaction appears immediately with temporary offline ID, Saved offline toast shown, queued for later sync

features.name: Transaction Management - Edit
features.description: Edit an existing transaction with offline support
user_interactions: Click edit icon on a transaction row
Modify amount, description, category, date, or type in modal form
Submit form to save changes
When online: transaction updated on server, list reflects changes immediately
When offline: cache updated immediately preserving real ID, Saved offline toast shown, edit queued for later sync

features.name: Transaction Management - Delete
features.description: Delete a transaction with offline support
user_interactions: Click delete icon on a transaction row
When online: transaction deleted from server, removed from list immediately
When offline: removed from cache immediately, Saved offline toast shown, delete queued for later sync

features.name: Offline-First Transaction Sync
features.description: Full offline-first support for transaction operations. Automatically queues mutations when offline and syncs when connectivity returns. Shows banners for connectivity and sync status. Persists Apollo cache and offline queue to localStorage.
user_interactions: When browser goes offline: amber You are offline banner appears at top with pending change count
When browser goes offline: can still create, edit, delete transactions; see Saved offline toast; transactions update in UI immediately
When browser comes back online with pending changes: blue pending sync banner appears; loading toast Syncing offline changes shown; sync runs automatically
On successful sync: All changes synced success toast; banners clear
On partial sync failure: N synced M failed will retry later warning toast; failed items remain in queue
Page reload while offline: deleted transactions do not reappear from persisted cache
Queue persists across page reloads via localStorage
Sign out purges Apollo cache

api_calls.endpoint: Nhost GraphQL: ADD_TRANSACTION, EDIT_TRANSACTION, DELETE_TRANSACTION mutations replayed from queue on reconnect

features.name: Category Management
features.description: CRUD operations for transaction categories with system vs user category distinction
user_interactions: View categories table showing name, type (income/expense), emoji icon, and transaction count
System categories shown but cannot be edited or deleted (user_id is null)
User categories can be edited: name, icon via emoji picker, type
User categories can be deleted
Click Add Category button to open create modal with name, emoji picker, and type selection
Delete action may fail with FK constraint error if category has remaining transactions

api_calls.endpoint: Nhost GraphQL: GET_CATEGORIES, INSERT_CATEGORY, UPDATE_CATEGORY, DELETE_CATEGORY

features.name: Language Switcher
features.description: Toggle between English and Russian language
user_interactions: Click language toggle button in footer to switch between EN and RU
All UI text updates immediately via i18next

known_limitations.issue: Two known TypeScript errors in chart widgets
known_limitations.impact: npm run build (tsc -b) will fail type-checking. null vs string mismatch in largestTransactions, Category | undefined in topCategories.

known_limitations.issue: Deleting a category with remaining transactions fails due to foreign key constraint
known_limitations.impact: User sees a generic error instead of a clear message. Category deletion is blocked by ON DELETE RESTRICT on category_id FK.

known_limitations.issue: applyQueueToRestoredCache only handles pending deletes, not adds or edits
known_limitations.impact: After page reload while offline, offline-created or offline-edited transactions disappear from cache until next sync. Only deletes are properly handled on cache restore.
Potential duplicate concurrent sync if the online event fires multiple times while already syncing. No isSyncing flag prevents overlapping sync operations.

known_limitations.issue: Offline queue has no size limit or deduplication
known_limitations.impact: Queue can grow unboundedly. Multiple edits to the same transaction create multiple queue entries with no deduplication.

known_limitations.issue: crypto.randomUUID has no fallback for older browsers
known_limitations.impact: Offline queue and temp IDs will break in browsers that do not support crypto.randomUUID (requires HTTPS or localhost).
